name: GitNexus
description: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine - GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph creator that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (Github, Gitlab, Azure, Local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built in Graph RAG Agent. Perfect for code exploration
one_liner: Turns any codebase into an interactive visual map you can ask questions about, entirely in your browser — no server, no code leaving your machine.
buyer: An engineering manager at a company with a large inherited codebase who needs new hires to get oriented fast.
business_use_cases: A new hire drops the company repo in and gets an interactive map plus a chat that answers 'how does X connect to Y'.
A consultant doing a codebase audit for a client visualizes the whole architecture before writing the assessment.
A due-diligence team evaluating an acquisition target's codebase gets a fast, private view of its structure.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid 'codebase onboarding audit' consulting built around this engine (the repo itself is noncommercially licensed, so sell the service, not a resold copy of the tool).

steal_this: Offer freelance 'new codebase orientation' sessions to startups that just hired their first engineer, using this to generate the map live.
